title: AIIE Protocol v5.0 — Legacy narrative crystal schema (use 35TAG v6.0.0 for new work)
description: Legacy t01_*-style binding. Canonical narrative state: 35TAG v6.0.0 (specs/35TAG_Standard_v6.0.0.md). T25 state_hash: SHA-256(JCS(TAG 01–34 except state_hash)). Fields are physical constraints when used with response_schema. This schema implements the Crystallization Constitution (§0–§3) in historical form.
author: Gemmina Intelligence LLC. — Tomohiko Nakamura

t01_epistemic_confidence.description: Epistemic confidence score. Set low when evidence is insufficient. 1.0 = verified fact, 0.0 = unconfirmed rumour.

t02_subject_origin.description: §0 Perspective constraint. The geopolitical observer whose narrative this represents. Determined by narrative framing, NOT by article language. GLOBAL is forbidden — must be mapped to the closest observer.

t03_predicate_type.description: The core action verb of the event. Maps the event to a computable predicate.

t04_object_actor.description: §1 Source fidelity. The entity receiving the action. null if not explicitly stated in source — inference is forbidden.

t05_location.description: §1 Source fidelity. Physical anchor of the event. city must be null if not stated in source.

t06_time_frame.description: §2 Temporal anchoring. ISO 8601 UTC/Z fixed format. Exactly 19 characters. Relative expressions ('today', 'recently') are forbidden. Must be computed from published_at as base.

t07_subject_actor.description: §1 Source fidelity. The entity initiating the action. Must appear explicitly in source.

t08_causality_direction.description: §3 Causal direction constraint. upstream = trigger/cause, midstream = ongoing event, downstream = consequence/effect. 'Complex correlation' is not an answer.

t09_strategic_interest_vector.description: 6-dimensional strategic interest vector. -1.0 = strongly negative impact, 0.0 = neutral, 1.0 = strongly positive impact for the subject_origin perspective.

t11_bias_component.description: Bias audit. emotional_load measures affective intensity of language. missing_viewpoints lists perspectives absent from the source.

t12_source_credibility.description: Historical credibility score of the source. Used as weight in CFI calculation.

t13_conflict_factuality_index.description: CFI score. Starts at 1.0. Physical contradictions (metadata, timestamps, geospatial inconsistencies) are subtracted as penalties.

t14_audit_aura.description: Visual trust indicator for frontend rendering. White = high confidence, SkyBlue = verified, PaleGreen = narrative conflict detected, Amber = low credibility, Red = physical contradiction detected.

global_synthesis.description: 400-character summary of the core geopolitical tension this event represents.

n_o_variants.description: Narrative Observer variants. The same event re-constructed from each geopolitical perspective. NOT translation — perspective re-generation. ~1400 chars each. Generated in Phase B (long_content_queue).

backbone_history.description: ~1000-character historical context. The causal chain leading to this event. Generated in Phase B.

deep_dive.description: ~1400-character multi-angle analysis. Generated in Phase B.

state_hash.description: T25 anchor. SHA-256( JCS( TAG 01..34 except state_hash ) ) per RFC 8785 — align with 35TAG v6.0.0 verifier (sdk/tag_v6.py).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this schema. Current: 5.0.0

x-crystallization-constitution.§0: subject_origin ∈ {jp, us, cn, gb, eu, qa} — perspective, not language. GLOBAL forbidden.
x-crystallization-constitution.§1: Fact ∈ Source — no entity generated beyond source. Unknown → null. Inference = forgery.
x-crystallization-constitution.§2: T = published_at + Δt — ISO 8601 UTC/Z only. Relative expressions forbidden.

x-state-hash-formula: state_hash = SHA-256( JCS( TAG 01..34 except state_hash ) ) per RFC 8785 — canonical: 35TAG v6.0.0
